## Stock History snapshot (03:00 daily)
Appends one row per product per day to `dashboard_stock_history`.

**Activate this immediately.** `dashboard_stock` only ever holds TODAY - yesterday's
on-hand is overwritten and gone. Every day this is off is a day of history that can
NEVER be recovered, and it is what later powers cover-days trend, stockout counts and
real inventory turns.

Runs at 03:00 so the 2-hourly products+stock sync has already refreshed the source.
Upsert on (product_id, snap_date): re-running today overwrites today and never touches
an earlier day.

Nothing reads this table yet. That is expected - it is accumulating for later.
